description: This file contains a PHP class named 'redmine' that provides an API client for interacting with a Redmine server. It includes methods for retrieving issues, projects, users, issue statuses, and adding or updating issues via the Redmine REST API. The class manages cURL sessions, handles authentication via an API key, and supports proxy configuration.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A PHP API client class for interacting with a Redmine project management server via REST API. Supports retrieving issues, projects, users, issue statuses, and adding or updating issues. Handles cURL configuration, API key authentication, and optional proxy settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the redmine object with URL, API key, and optional configuration such as proxy settings.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL resource with appropriate settings, including user agent, proxy configuration, and SSL options.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific issue by ID.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of issues, optionally filtered.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Adds a new issue using an XML object, with optional reporter.

methods.name: addIssueFromXMLString
methods.description: Adds a new issue using an XML string, with optional reporter.

methods.name: addIssueNoteFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Updates an existing issue with a note via an XML object, with optional reporter.

methods.name: getProjectByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a project by its identifier.

methods.name: getIssueStatuses
methods.description: Returns a list of issue statuses.

methods.name: checkUserExistence
methods.description: Checks if a user with the given login exists in Redmine.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users from Redmine.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method to perform a GET request to the given URL.

methods.name: _request_xml
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request expecting XML response, parses it into a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs the HTTP request using cURL with appropriate headers and authentication.
